question: ‘Atla Taddi’, a festival celebrated by married and unmarried women alike to seek the blessings of Devi Gauri for a long and happy married life and a suitable groom, respectively, is celebrated in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atla Taddi** is a festival celebrated in the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• This festival is celebrated by both married and unmarried women.
 
• Married women seek the blessings of **Devi Gauri** for a long and happy married life.
 
• Unmarried women pray for a **suitable groom**.
 
• The festival involves various traditional rituals and fasting, which are observed with great enthusiasm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The festival of Atla Taddi is similar to the North Indian festival of **Karva Chauth**.
 
• It is usually celebrated in the month of **Aswayuja** according to the Telugu calendar.
 
• The celebrations include various cultural activities and community gatherings.
 
• Women dress up in traditional attire and adorn themselves with jewelry and henna.
 
• The rituals often take place in the evening, followed by a night of singing and dancing.
